name: Cis-(+/-)-3-allylfentanyl
summary: 3-Allylfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analogue of fentanyl.

pharmacology.text: 3-Allylfentanyl has effects similar to fentanyl, although it is only 0.13x-0.14x as potent by weight.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs vary based on strength and are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening.
